description: ADR 0158 (F2, M34 fuzz shrink): constant throttle 0.378 + full left lock from 30 km/h, cargo24 on dry asphalt. The combination rolls over at t~4 s (all 10 wheels lift). Before ADR 0158 the runner had no chassis colliders, so the combination fell through the road (CoM y = -3070 m at 30 s, |v| 765 km/h; the reported 275 km/h was the free-fall velocity projected on the tumbling tractor forward axis) while E = KE + PE never grew (no energy injection). Now the tractor/trailer colliders (mirror of the Unity graybox BoxColliders) catch it: it lands on its side, slides and stops.

checks.source: driving phase before the rollover: per-step velocity change <= 0.35 m/s (kerb-scenario ceiling)
whole run incl. the side impact: <= sqrt(2 g dh) = 4.18 m/s, dh = 0.89 m = trailer CoM drop from its tip-over apex (2.164 m) to lying on its side (1.275 m = half width), ADR 0158; measured 2.04 m/s
driving phase: kingpin constraint error <= 5 mm
whole run: coupling holds through the side impact (measured 24.5 mm peak at landing, 9 mm lying: colliders and the soft kingpin joint are slightly over-constrained), no blow-up; ADR 0158
EU limiter 90 km/h (docs/04 s5), same margin as top_speed_flat_comb (+0.5); before ADR 0158: 275.4 km/h
no fall-through: both CoMs stay above the road (static tractor CoM 1.05 m, lying on its side >= 1.25 m); before ADR 0158: -3070 m
collider corners penetrate the road by <= 2 cm (Baumgarte slop 5 mm), ADR 0158
the rollover ends on the chassis colliders (scenario meaning), ADR 0158
no energy source in free flight: E = KE + PE must not grow between samples, ADR 0158
throttle 0.378 only replaces losses while upright; nothing may raise E above its t=0 value (2.031 MJ) + 5 % (measured max 2.055 MJ at t~0.5 s, +1.2 %)
the overturned combination slides to a stop (body friction 0.6 = Unity default PhysicsMaterial) and stays at rest
